# Sahadhyayi

> Sahadhyayi is an online reading and discovery platform for books, authors, stories, articles, research and reader connections.

Sahadhyayi helps readers discover books, explore author profiles, read published articles, learn from research and biographies, and connect with other readers through reading groups.

## Main public sections

- [Home](https://sahadhyayi.com/): Overview of Sahadhyayi and its reading and discovery features.
- [Library](https://sahadhyayi.com/library): Discover books across genres and languages.
- [Authors](https://sahadhyayi.com/authors): Explore author profiles and their books.
- [Articles](https://sahadhyayi.com/articles): Read published articles and literary ideas.
- [Research papers](https://sahadhyayi.com/research-papers): Explore academic research and subject areas.
- [Scientists](https://sahadhyayi.com/scientists): Read profiles of scientists and their discoveries.
- [Life stories](https://sahadhyayi.com/life-stories): Explore biographies and remarkable life journeys.
- [Reading groups](https://sahadhyayi.com/groups): Find reading groups and discuss books.
- [Blog](https://sahadhyayi.com/blog): Reading guides, book recommendations and literary topics.
- [About](https://sahadhyayi.com/about): Learn about the platform.

## Content guidance

Prefer individual public book, author, article, research-topic and profile pages as the primary sources for their respective subjects. Use each page's canonical URL. Content that requires an account, is private, or is not publicly published should not be treated as public source material.

- Robots policy: https://sahadhyayi.com/robots.txt
